title: mcp: the metadata tools and list_actions answer a fault with its raw text (or a driver code), where the /meta door answers 500 INTERNAL_ERROR
body:
domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5p3T5YWhLjurajudnQ

Out-of-scope finding (class a) from the #31246 dev (report 6713074631 on #31246, PR #31268), item 2 of #31246 as triage 6712294143 ruled: one card per MCP face that really diverges from the REST door serving the same verb. Filed by `domain:server#6`. ⛔ Not a claim. Measured by the dev on `main` with PR #31245 merged.

Reader: the seat that owns `packages/mcp`.

Suggested-grade: p3 (no named production producer measured: metadata reads run no record hooks, so only faults reach these members).

**Observed:** `tools/call list_objects`, `describe_object`, `validate_expression`, `list_actions`, with the bridge member throwing a bare `Error` or a driver string code, answer the bare text (`'socket hang up'`) or `{ code: SQLITE_BUSY, message: driver text }`; the `/meta` door (`handleRouteError`) answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR 'Internal server error'` and `500 DATABASE_ERROR 'Internal data error'`.

**Expected:** these tools answer a fault the way `/meta` does, through its reader (`isServerFault` / `logServerFault` family), never a copy: no raw fault text to the agent, the fault logged server-side. Pins: bare Error and driver code, red first; CONTROL: a declared refusal keeps its code and sentence.

Dedupe words: mcp metadata tools fault text, list_actions errorResultWithCode, mcp meta door parity.
